title: Retention-deadline push test: make its put independent of the short transport budget so contention cannot fail it
outcome: Retention-deadline push test: make its put independent of the short transport budget so contention cannot fail it
acceptance: `a_retention_removal_past_the_deadline_is_a_warning_and_holds_the_lock` no longer depends on the put finishing within the test's short transport deadline: the blocked removal's deadline is independent of the time the put took (for example through a test-only budget for retention), and the test still shows the warning, the held lock, the kept ledger and the next push finishing the removal
